notes.title: Game Soundtrack Released + Bundle
notes.content:
[h1]Hi guys![/h1]
I released the game's soundtrack. The soundtrack will have a 30% discount for two weeks.

I also created a bundle of the game and soundtrack. If you buy them together, it will be 20% more profitable. Attention! This is only suitable for those who have not yet purchased the game.

[h1]Links:[/h1]

[b]ASCIILL Soundtrack: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947920/ASCIILL_Soundtrack/]store.steampowered.com/app/1947920/ASCIILL_Soundtrack/[/url]

[b]Bundle "ASCIILL + Soundtrack":[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41983/Game__Soundtrack/]store.steampowered.com/bundle/41983/Game__Soundtrack/[/url]

[h3]Have a nice week everyone![/h3]

notes.title: Update Notes for ver. 1.2.2
notes.content:
1. Heartthrob achievement bug - FIXED
2. Unable to quickly change direction - FIXED
3. More contrasting coins - ADDED
4. Five new flags for screensaver mode - ADDED
    Press "U" in screensaver to switch to flags. Then select the flag by pressing: "U", "F", "C", "A", "R", "T", "L", "I" or "O".

notes.title: Unlimited procedural generated levels // Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h3]1. Unlimited procedural generated levels in Challenge mode. [/h3]
Play without limits!

[h3]2. Interactive cassette deca in Screensaver mode. [/h3]
Controls:
[b]B[/b] - show/hide deca
[b]Up/Down[/b] - volume
[b]Left/Right[/b] - stereo balance
[b]PageUp/PageDown[/b] - previous/next track

[h3]3. Several bugs were fixed.[/h3]
